text: Databricks & Delta Lake Lesson 43 already covered column masks and row filters, in full, with one worked example each. This course assumes you have that picture. This lesson is everything that happens once one table becomes forty.

Lesson 43 used is_member, which checks a workspace-local group. Unity Catalog's identity model is account-level. is_account_group_member checks an account-level group instead, consistently, no matter which attached workspace the query runs from.

Writing one function and one ALTER TABLE is reasonable for one table. It doesn't scale to dozens of PII columns across many tables updated by hand — that's exactly how masks quietly drift out of sync.
The systematic fix ties protection to a tag the column carries, not to a specific column's name. One tag-based policy applies to every column carrying it, in every table, present or future.
Lesson 43 protects a column. A tag-based policy protects every column that is what the tag says it is. Next up: Delta Sharing, and what changes when the recipient isn't even in your metastore.
